english: Your account cannot do this. Ask an admin if you need it.
kinyarwanda: Konti yawe ntiyemerewe gukora ibi. Niba ubikeneye, baza umuyobozi wa sisitemu.

english: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it.
kinyarwanda: Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga? Saba umuyobozi wa sisitemu kurisubiramo.

english: Checks held readings and sees households.
kinyarwanda: Agenzura ibipimo byahagaritswe kandi abona ingo.

english: As an officer, and sees everyone's activity.
kinyarwanda: Nk'umukozi, kandi abona ibikorwa by'abakozi bose.

english: As a supervisor, and manages staff accounts.
Your sign-ins and decisions, newest first.
kinyarwanda: Igihe winjiriye n'ibyemezo wafashe, ibya vuba mbere.

english: Every sign-in, decision and account change, newest first.
kinyarwanda: Kwinjira kose, ibyemezo byose n'impinduka zose kuri konti, ibya vuba mbere.

english: Add people, set what they can do, and reset forgotten passwords.
kinyarwanda: Ongeramo abantu, ugene ibyo bemerewe gukora, kandi usubiremo amagambo y'ibanga yibagiranye.

english: 3 to 32 lowercase letters or digits; dots and dashes allowed. Example: a.mukamana
kinyarwanda: Inyuguti nto cyangwa imibare kuva kuri 3 kugeza kuri 32; akadomo n'akanyerezo biremewe. Urugero: a.mukamana

english: Officers check readings. Supervisors also see everyone's activity. Admins also manage accounts.
kinyarwanda: Abakozi bagenzura ibipimo. Abagenzuzi babona n'ibikorwa by'abakozi bose. Abayobozi ba sisitemu bacunga na konti.

english: Enter the full name and a username of 3 to 32 lowercase letters or digits.
kinyarwanda: Andika amazina yose n'izina ukoresha rifite inyuguti nto cyangwa imibare kuva kuri 3 kugeza kuri 32.

english: That username is taken. Choose another.
Give {name} a new temporary password? Their current password stops working.
kinyarwanda: Guha {name} ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo rishya? Iryo akoresha ubu rizahita rireka gukora.

english: It is shown only now. Give it to the person directly (not by email), and ask them to change it under My account.
kinyarwanda: Rigaragara ubu gusa. Riha nyiraryo imbonankubone (atari kuri imeyili), maze umusabe kurihindura muri Konti yanjye.

english: At least {count} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
kinyarwanda: Nibura inyuguti {count}. Interuro ngufi yoroshye kwibuka.

english: The two new passwords are not the same.
kinyarwanda: Amagambo y'ibanga mashya yombi ntabwo ari kimwe.

english: Your current password is not right.
kinyarwanda: Ijambo ry'ibanga ukoresha ubu si ryo.

english: Password changed. Use it next time you sign in.
kinyarwanda: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Rikoreshe ubutaha winjira.
